feature.name: JSONPath parse, find, and update core
feature.description: Extract jsonpath-ng expression parsing and evaluation (including filter expressions) without CLI or original package import.
included_behaviors: parse JSONPath strings into expression objects
find matching values in dict/list document trees
update values at matching paths in place

entanglement.description: JSONPath couples lexer/parser grammar, AST node types, tree walking, filter evaluation, and in-place update semantics.
signals: PLY lexer/parser builds AST from path strings
ext filter parser adds comparison and @ context

output.import: import featurelifted; from featurelifted import parse; from featurelifted.jsonpath import JSONPath; from featurelifted.exceptions import JsonPathLexerError, JsonPathParserError

public_spec.title: JSONPath parse, find, and update core
public_spec.summary: Extract a task-scoped subset of `jsonpath_ng` into a standalone `featurelifted` package.

behaviors.text: The extracted feature must support this observable behavior: parse JSONPath strings into expression objects. Required observable cases include parse find simple path; root child fields; filter expression selects items; invalid expression raises.

The extracted feature must support this observable behavior: find matching values in dict/list document trees. Required observable cases include parse find simple path; wildcard array find; root child fields; update nested path.
The extracted feature must support this observable behavior: update values at matching paths in place. Required observable cases include update value in place; update nested path.

The extracted feature must support this observable behavior: filter expressions with comparison operators. Required observable cases include filter expression selects items; invalid expression raises.

The extracted feature must support this observable behavior: array slices and wildcard/index segments. Required observable cases include wildcard array find; bracket slice selects range; negative index selects last.

The package exposes the required task API paths `featurelifted.parse`, `featurelifted.exceptions`, `featurelifted.exceptions.JsonPathLexerError`, `featurelifted.exceptions.JsonPathParserError` with the kinds and callable signatures listed in this contract.

public_spec.public_vs_hidden_note: Benchmark evaluator tests remain private. Each evaluator test maps to the public behaviors above and only deepens examples, boundaries, or combinations within those declared behaviors.
